sections.heading: What we build
paragraphs: OHWUT brings everyday online shopping together with a purchase model where the price of participating products decreases as more people join.
The official destination for OHWUT products, shopping and service information is ohwut.com.

sections.heading: How OHWUT works
paragraphs: OHWUT supports ordinary online shopping and group-driven price drops: a participating product can become less expensive as more customers join.
Product details, availability, orders and purchases are handled on OHWUT's official site, not this corporate information site.
